outcome: Volume density of placental components (chorionic villi, intervillous spaces, blood vessels, syncytiotrophoblast)
Extravillous trophoblast cell (EVT) parameters (volume, number, cytoplasm diameter, nucleus diameter, nucleus to cytoplasm ratio)
cohort: 20 placentas (10 from pregnancies complicated with SGA-IUGR and 10 controls) collected after cesarean surgery
finding: Placentas from SGA-IUGR pregnancies showed significant reductions in various volumetric parameters, including total volume, volume density of placental components, and EVT parameters, suggesting a link between placental histological changes and SGA-IUGR.
